{{Short description|Historian of Indian mathematics (1918-2007)}}
'''Kripa Shankar Shukla''' (10 July 1918 - 22 September 2007) was a historian of [[Indian mathematics]]. He was awarded the [[Doctor of Letters|DLitt]] degree by [[Lucknow University]] in 1955 for his thesis on “''Astronomy in the Seventh Century India: Bhāskara I and His Works''” which was completed under the guidance of [[A. N. Singh]].  He retired in 1979.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Radha Charan Gupta |title=Dr. Kripa Shankar Shukla, veteran historian of Hindu astronomy and mathematics |journal=Ganita Bharati |date=1998 |volume=20 |issue=1-4}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Yukio Ohashi |title=Obituary: Kripa Shankar Shukla (1918–2007) |journal=Indian Journal of History of Science |date=2008 |volume=43 |issue=3 |pages=475–485}}</ref> 

Shukla published several important source works in Indian mathematics and astronomy with translations, notes, explanations. He also authored a large number of research papers bringing out many previously unknown facts about the historical development of mathematics in India. He continued his active research even after retiring from his official position in Lucknow University. Shukla supervised the research work of several research scholars
including that of Yukio Ohashi (1955 - 2019) from Japan whose dissertation was titled "A History of Astronomical Instruments in India".<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Michio Yano |title=Obituary to Dr Yukio Ôhashi |journal=Indian Journal of History of Science |date=March 2020 |volume=55 |issue=1 |url=https://www.cc.kyoto-su.ac.jp/~yanom/pdf/yano_papers/Yano_2020_Ohashi_Obiturary_IJHS_Vol55_1.pdf |access-date=2 August 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Yukio Ohashi |title=Prof. K. S. Shukla’s contribution to the study of the history of Hindu astronomy |journal=Ganita Bharati |date=1995 |volume=17 |issue=1-4 |pages=29-44}}</ref>

==Publications==

=== Source works brought out by K. S. Shula ===

The important source works brought out by Shukla include the following:

# ''Sūrya-siddhānta'' with the commentary of Parameśvara (1957) [https://archive.org/details/suryasiddhanta-shukla/page/n1/mode/2up?view=theater]
# ''Pāṭīgaṇita'' of Śrīdharācārya (1959)  [https://archive.org/details/patiganitaofsridharacharyawithacommentarykripashankarshukla_340_/mode/2up?view=theater]
# ''Mahābhāskarīya'' of Bhāskara I (1960)  [https://archive.org/details/mahabhaskariyakripashankarshukla_114_z/page/n7/mode/2up?view=theater]
# ''Laghubhāskarīya'' of Bhāskara I (1963) [https://archive.org/details/laghubhaskariyakripashankarshukla_202003_161_I/page/n1/mode/2up?view=theater]
# ''Dhīkoṭida-karaṇa'' of Śrīpati (1969)
# ''Bījagaṇitāvataṃsa'' of Nārāyaṇa Paṇḍita (1970)
# ''Āryabhaṭīya'' of Āryabhaṭa (1976) [https://archive.org/details/aryabhatiyaofaryabhattaenglishtranslationkripashankarshuklasarmak.v.vol1_954_l/mode/2up?view=theater]
# ''Āryabhaṭīya'' of Āryabhaṭa with the commentary of Bhāskara I and Someśvara (1976)
# ''Karaṇaratna'' of Devācārya (1979) [https://archive.org/details/karanaratnadevacaryaed.kripashankarshukla_566_Y/mode/2up?view=theater]
# ''Vaṭeśvarasiddhānta'' and ''Gola'' of Vaṭeśvara (2 Vols) (1985–86) [https://archive.org/details/vateshwarsiddhantaandgolakripashankarshuklapart1_423_n/mode/2up?view=theater]
# ''Laghumānasa'' of Mañjula (1990) [https://archive.org/details/laghumanasaofmanjulaacriticalstudykripashankarshuklaijhsvol25suppliment_392_U]
# ''Gaṇitapañcaviṃśī'' (published posthumously) (2017)

=== Research papers ===

Aditya Kolachana, K. Mahesh and K. Ramasubramanian have brought out a 754-page volume containing a collection of selected articles by Shukla under the title "Studies in Indian Mathematics and Astronomy" in 2019.<ref>{{cite book |last1=Aditya Kolachana, K. Mahesh, K. Ramasubramanian |title=Studies in Indian Mathematics and Astronomy: Selected Articles of Kripa Shankar Shukla |date=2019 |publisher=Hindustan Book Agency/Springer |location=New Delhi |url=https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-981-13-7326-8 |access-date=2 August 2023}}</ref>

==Awards and accolades==

The awards and prizes conferred on Shukla include the following:

* Awarded Banerji Research Prize of [[University of Lucknow]] 
* 1984: Elected Fellow of the [[National Academy of Sciences, India]]
* 1988: Selected as a Corresponding Member of the [[International Academy of the History of Science]], Paris.
